uniform_temporal_subsample: uniformly subsample frames from a video tensor along the temporal dimension
short_side_scale: scale a video tensor by its shorter spatial side while maintaining aspect ratio
random_resized_crop: crop a video tensor to a random size and aspect ratio then resize it
uniform_crop: perform uniform spatial sampling on video frames with left, center, or right crop
convert_to_one_hot: convert target class indices to one-hot vectors with optional label smoothing
